# Mobile Fullscreen Toggle Solution Design
**AI-generated by:** Alson (A.I Agent)

## Design

1. Add an SSR-safe `useFullscreen` hook that owns support detection, current fullscreen state, `fullscreenchange` subscription, enter/exit operations, and rejected-request handling.
2. Add a reusable `FullscreenToggle` component using the existing button primitive and Lucide icons. Provide an accessible label and title for enter and exit states.
3. Reuse `useIsMobile` so the control follows the existing `<768px` application breakpoint.
4. Mount the component in the custom `YouTubePlayer` playback controls beside the mute action, keeping the control with the session recording actions on mobile.
5. Request fullscreen from `document.documentElement` only from the button click. Do not persist fullscreen state as an application preference; the browser owns that state.

## Fallback

When the API is absent, fullscreen is disabled, or the request rejects, do not replace or block the normal responsive layout. Keep the control hidden or disabled and avoid an unhandled promise rejection.

## Artifact Need

No additional maintained project artifact is currently needed. Source changes and Build/Measure evidence in this run are sufficient.
